title: Privacy Policy
bodyHtml:
Overview

HomeWODRx ("we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.

We do not sell your personal information to third parties. Ever.

Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly to us, including:

  • Email address — if you sign up for the Daily 20 email or new blog posts
  • Messages — feedback or support requests you send via the Contact page, processed through our form provider, Web3Forms
  • Account information and workout data — if you created an account on the previous version of the site, your email address, display name and logged results are still stored. New sign-ups are paused for now.

To understand how the site is used, we count visits without cookies. For each page view we record the page address, the site you came from, your device type (phone, tablet or computer) and your country. To count each visitor once per day, we create an anonymous code from your IP address and browser that changes every day; we don't store your IP address, and the daily codes are deleted after two days, so visits can't be linked to you or to each other over time. We also record the words typed into the site's search box, so we can see what content people are looking for.

We also use Google Analytics, which uses cookies to collect information about your visit, such as the pages you view, how you reached the site, your device and browser, and your approximate location (city or region, worked out from your IP address). Advertising features are turned off, and we don't use this information to identify you. In the EEA, UK and Switzerland, Google Analytics only runs if you accept it in the cookie banner.

When you sign up for email, Cloudflare Turnstile collects limited device and browser signals to confirm you're not a bot. Videos are embedded from YouTube in privacy-enhanced mode and only load, and contact YouTube, when you press play.

How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Provide, maintain, and improve the site and its features
  • Send the emails you signed up for
  • Respond to your feedback and support requests
  • Understand how the site is used so we can make it better
  • Detect and prevent bot sign-ups and abuse

Legal Basis for Processing

If you're located in the EEA, UK, or another jurisdiction with similar requirements, we process your personal data on the following legal bases under the GDPR:

  • Consent — sending the emails you signed up for, and Google Analytics cookies if you accept them in the cookie banner. You can unsubscribe at any time from the link in every email, and change your cookie choice at any time with Cookie choices at the bottom of every page.
  • Contract — keeping the account information and workout data of members who created an account.
  • Legitimate interests — cookie-free visit counting and bot protection (Cloudflare Turnstile), to understand and secure the site. We've limited the data collected to what's needed for those purposes.
  • Legal obligation — where we're required to disclose information to comply with the law.

Information Sharing

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information. We share information only with the service providers who help us run the site, each acting as a data processor under their own privacy policy and terms:

  • Supabase — database, email sign-ups and visit counts
  • Resend — sending email (the Daily 20, announcements, account emails)
  • Vercel — website hosting
  • Web3Forms — processes Contact page submissions and relays them to us by email
  • Cloudflare — Turnstile bot protection on email sign-up
  • Google — Google Analytics, to understand how the site is used
  • YouTube — embedded videos, only after you press play

We may also disclose information if required by law or to protect the rights and safety of our users.

International Transfers

HomeWODRx and the service providers listed above are based in or operate infrastructure in the United States. If you're accessing the site from the EEA, UK, or elsewhere outside the US, your information will be transferred to and processed in the US. Our service providers maintain appropriate safeguards for these transfers, such as Standard Contractual Clauses, as required under their respective privacy and data processing terms.

Data Retention

We keep your email address for as long as you stay subscribed. Unsubscribing stops the emails; to have your address deleted entirely, contact us.

Members' account information and workout data are kept for as long as the account exists; contact us to have an account deleted. We keep records we're required to keep for legal, security, or fraud-prevention purposes only as long as necessary for those purposes.

Google Analytics data is kept for 14 months. Contact form messages are retained as long as needed to respond to and resolve your inquiry. Visit counts are kept as totals; the daily visitor codes behind them are deleted after two days.

Cookies

The site uses Google Analytics cookies to understand how it's used, and no advertising cookies. In the EEA, UK and Switzerland they're only set if you accept them. The only other cookie is an essential login cookie for the site's administrator. See our Cookie Policy for details and how to change your choice.

Your Rights

If you're located in the EEA, UK, or another jurisdiction with similar data protection laws, you have the right to:

  • Access the personal data we hold about you
  • Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
  • Erase your personal data ("right to be forgotten")
  • Restrict how we process your data
  • Object to processing based on legitimate interests
  • Port your data to another service in a structured, machine-readable format
  • Withdraw consent at any time for anything we process based on consent (e.g. emails you signed up for), without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal
  • Lodge a complaint with your local data protection supervisory authority if you believe we haven't handled your data properly

To exercise any of these rights, contact us via the Contact page and we will respond within 30 days. You can unsubscribe from emails at any time using the link in every email.

Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please reach out:

Questions? Contact us
